breaking_news.headline: States sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros blockbuster merger
breaking_news.summary: California is among the states suing to block Paramount from buying Warner Bros. Discovery in a Hollywood mega-merger that would unite some of the nation's largest movie studios and TV newsrooms.

breaking_news.headline: 'The Trojan Teddy Bear': The promise and peril of childhood in the age of AI
breaking_news.summary: AI is moving beyond chatbots and into toys, dolls, and robots built to befriend children. A leading child-development expert says the technology offers real promise — but also risks crowding out the human relationships children need most.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation slowed sharply -- but it may not last
breaking_news.summary: Annual inflation hit 3.5% in June, down from May's more than three-year high — but the resumption of the conflict with Iran threaten to push up inflation as energy costs once again spike.

breaking_news.headline: Mystery bidder buys T. rex nicknamed 'Gus' for a record $50 million
breaking_news.summary: A T-rex fossil billed as one of the world's largest specimens was sold for a record $50.1 million Tuesday to a mystery bidder. But many aren't happy about it.

breaking_news.headline: American AI is expensive. Some startups are turning to cheap Chinese models
breaking_news.summary: AI is a fast-growing business expense. Some companies are cutting costs by switching to cheaper Chinese AI models.

breaking_news.headline: China's economy grows 4.3% in Q2, slowest since late 2022
breaking_news.summary: Lagging consumer spending and business investment offset the boost from strong exports thanks partly to the boom in artificial intelligence.

breaking_news.headline: Federal Reserve looks for 'secret sauce' behind a successful Wisconsin toolmaker
breaking_news.summary: Business is booming for Snap-on, a Wisconsin company that has made tools for professional mechanics for more than a century. It recently got a fact-finding visit from the head of the Chicago Federal Reserve Bank.

breaking_news.headline: Kalshi says it's not a sportsbook even as World Cup bets surge
breaking_news.summary: The betting site Kalshi emerged as a dominant sports betting platform during the World Cup. But the company avoids billions of dollars in taxes by insisting it is not a sports gambling operator.

breaking_news.headline: Canada fires prompt US air quality alerts as smoke blankets major cities
breaking_news.summary: Smoke from more than 800 blazes has filled major cities from Toronto and New York, to parts of the US Midwest and Great Lakes.

breaking_news.headline: Uganda suspends school trips after 20 pupils die in bus crash
breaking_news.summary: Thousands are killed on Uganda's roads each year but this is one of its deadliest accidents involving children.

breaking_news.headline: Philippines condemns monkey video on Chinese media as racist
breaking_news.summary: The AI video on China Daily showed a monkey in Philippine garments singing its claims to the South China Sea.

breaking_news.headline: Japan relaxes royal succession rules - but ban on female emperors remains
breaking_news.summary: The law now allows the adoption of male distant relatives aged over 15 back into the imperial family.

breaking_news.headline: More than 500 Rohingya vanished at sea - what happened?
breaking_news.summary: Two boats carrying an estimated 530 Rohingyas have disappeared since leaving Myanmar on 29 June.

breaking_news.headline: Trump alleges China meddled in 2020 election and questions voting security ahead of midterms
breaking_news.summary: China said Trump's claims were fabricated and US Democrats said he was paving the way to undermine November's elections.

breaking_news.headline: Iran accuses US of hitting civilian infrastructure
breaking_news.summary: The US military says its attacks were intended to "further degrade Iranian military capabilities".

breaking_news.headline: Trump Media to sell instant access to 'market-moving' social posts
breaking_news.summary: Trump Media is launching a fast, paid feed to its most influential posts for Wall Street traders.

breaking_news.headline: Who is the frontrunner to be the UK's next chancellor?
breaking_news.summary: Andy Burnham will be moving into Downing Street next week, and a question remains over who will be his neighbour in Number 11.

breaking_news.headline: I wouldn't marry him until he paid off his debt, now I'm in charge of our money
breaking_news.summary: Sarah and her husband have shared one account for 25 years, but she says managing it falls to her.

breaking_news.headline: The financial winners and losers from the World Cup
breaking_news.summary: Big bucks are being made from the 2026 tournament off the field, but who is raking in the most, and who is losing out?

breaking_news.headline: Why has British Steel been nationalised?
breaking_news.summary: The UK's only remaining plant making virgin steel has been taken into public ownership after years of uncertainty over its future.
